formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): The paper states VTF behavior is observed within the tested temperature range (room temperature to 79 °C) but does not provide specific VFT fitting parameters (prefactor, activation energy, T0) for any formulation. It mentions VTF fits are shown in Fig. 2a but the numerical values are not printed in the text or tables.
formulations.Notes: Polymer dried at 120 °C for 3 days before use; solvent residues removed in vacuum oven at 60 °C for 2 days.
formulations.Reference: Sun, B., Mindemark, J., Edström, K., & Brandell, D. (2013). Polycarbonate-based solid polymer electrolytes for Li-ion batteries. Solid State Ionics, 236-237, 1-7.
